design_findings: AutoGM and CozyMode are mode/profile experiences, not human account roles or alternate state engines.
Solo is participation topology; Connected Cozy is CozyMode with invited participants and ordinary independent subject authority.
Automation controllers are nonhuman service actors and never receive global GM role authority.
State-affecting automation requires explicit versioned delegation plus fresh owning-domain authorization on every command.
Every automated operation is classified automatic, bounded automatic, proposal-required, human-required, or prohibited.
Optional AI remains presentation/proposal assistance and cannot own mechanical legality, hidden-state authority, human choices, permissions, delegation, approval, or Event commit.
AutoGM scenario-private truth is available only through a governed deterministic scenario/controller projection; optional AI does not receive raw scenario-private truth by default.
Exit/disconnect never implies background authority; initial AutoGM is foreground-only and Cozy background progress is explicit and bounded.
Automation run records govern execution/provenance only; ordinary domain state and accepted Events remain the single authoritative history.
Eleven additive successor touch points are identified without reopening completed Stage A milestones.
